title: Implementation Plan for Hacker-Style Encrypted Messaging Interface

steps.description: Create the complete standalone application in a single file. This includes: 1) A Canvas-based rendering engine for the 'Matrix' background effect. 2) A CSS-driven UI layer using glassmorphism and 'Cyber-noir' styling. 3) A JavaScript state-driven animation controller to handle 'Decryption' and 'Pulse' effects independently of the UI logic.
steps.testCriteria: Verify that the Canvas background renders smoothly, CSS glassmorphism is applied to UI elements, and the 'Decryption' animation triggers correctly upon message receipt.

verificationGateChecklist: AST code health clean (no empty catch, no any)
